The submitted shore X consists exactly of sets σ whose complement CONTAINS a triangle, i.e. X=T^∨ on the full ten-vertex edge set. Its prior theorem gives T≃5S3∨S4 and S5 modules H3(T;Q)=sgn⊗Q5,H4(T;Q)=trivial. Combinatorial Alexander duality yields H3(X)=H^4(T)=Z and H4(X)=H^3(T)=Z5 and vanishing otherwise. Since X contains the complete two-skeleton of the nine-simplex, X is 2-connected; Hurewicz+Whitehead furnish the stated wedge S3∨5S4. Equivariant Alexander duality twists by the orientation sign of the action on the TEN edge vertices: a label transposition induces THREE swaps of 2-subsets, hence the twist is sgn on S5 (verified for all 120 permutations). Accordingly H3(X;Q)=sgn⊗triv=sgn and H4(X;Q)=sgn⊗(sgn⊗Q5)=Q5, EXACTLY the claimed characters. The other shore is isomorphic by 2/3-subset complement. Therefore every claimed homotopy and rational representation conclusion follows from the earlier published theorem plus standard duality/homotopy facts, despite different graph terminology.
